'''October 2001 Colorado Springs tournament (6 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Hobbytown, Colorado Springs, Colorado on 6 October 2001. [[Derek Mower]] won it. It is known from Danny Hummel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3060">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-16-nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucksd3060/ nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucks], DeckTech (Dan "Nexis" Hummel, 16 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-16-nexis-colorado-springs-10-6-hb-sucksd3060/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Hobbytown, Colorado Springs, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Derek Mower]]
